scenario.title: Review a lot-tracked training stock example
scenario.goal: Trace non-medicinal training stock through lot identity, expiry metadata, sale, return and supplier settlement.
steps: Review the training items, lot identifiers and stated expiry dates.
Trace the purchase and receipt into the stock and payable accounts.
Review the sale, returned quantity and linked customer credit.
Check the supplier payment and the remaining lot quantity/value.
checks: All products are non-medicinal sample training items.
No dispensing, patient, prescription, controlled-substance or pharmacy compliance workflow is implemented.
Expiry metadata is illustrative fixture data, not a regulatory control.
